format: Transparent SVG with sampled geometry animation; original PNG and raster-backed original.svg preserve the supplied pixels

states.name: Original
states.detail: The original pose. Your supplied PNG is used for the five-branch team.

states.name: Breathe
states.detail: The branches stretch and settle with a slow breath.

states.name: Drift in 3D
states.detail: Nodes pass in front of and behind the centre.

states.name: Curious
states.detail: A small lean, a look around, then back to you.

states.name: Listening
states.detail: The network leans inward to catch the next signal.

states.name: Thinking
states.detail: A turning constellation, with signals travelling between nodes.

states.name: Connecting
states.detail: Branches reach outward and make contact in sequence.

states.name: Responding
states.detail: A wave moves from the centre out through the team.

states.name: Grow a team
states.detail: One new branch grows from your chosen parent. The existing team stays in place.

states.name: Consolidate
states.detail: The current team gathers into fewer, counted groups.

states.name: Form subteams
states.detail: A new lead grows from your chosen parent, followed by two adjacent assistants.

states.name: Little jump
states.detail: A squash, a light jump, and a springy landing.

states.name: Jitter
states.detail: A quick shiver runs along the branches, then releases.

states.name: Needs you
states.detail: The upper node gives a small nudge to catch your attention.

states.name: Complete
states.detail: One buoyant lift settles into a check.

states.name: Interrupted
states.detail: A brief recoil, then a held point of attention.

states.name: Paused
states.detail: The network holds until you are ready.

states.name: Disconnected
states.detail: Open connections show a source that needs a check.
